definitions.cadre: a small group of people trained for a particular purpose or profession.
definitions.card: thick, stiff paper or thin cardboard.
definitions.cedar: a tall coniferous tree that typically yields fragrant, durable wood.
definitions.cred: acceptability among fashionable young urban people.
definitions.creed: a system of religious belief; a faith.
definitions.dace: a freshwater fish related to the carp, typically living in running water.
definitions.dare: have the courage to do something.
definitions.decrease: make or become smaller or fewer in size, amount, intensity, or degree.
definitions.decree: an official order that has the force of law.
definitions.deep: extending far down or in from the top or surface.
definitions.deer: a hoofed grazing or browsing animal, with branched bony antlers that are shed annually and typically borne only by the male.
definitions.drape: arrange (cloth or clothing) loosely on or round something.
definitions.padre: a chaplain in the armed services.
definitions.precede: come or go before in time, order, or position.
definitions.rapeseed: seeds of the rape plant, used for oil.
definitions.read: look at and understand the meaning of (written or printed matter) by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.
definitions.reed: a tall, slender-leaved plant of the grass family, growing in water or on marshy ground.
definitions.sacred: connected with a deity and so deserving veneration; holy.
definitions.screed: a long speech or piece of writing, typically a tedious one.
definitions.secede: withdraw formally from membership of a federal union or a political or religious organization.
definitions.seed: a flowering plant's unit of reproduction, capable of developing into another such plant.
definitions.spade: a tool with a sharp-edged, rectangular metal blade and a long handle, used for digging.
definitions.speed: the rate at which someone or something moves or operates or is able to move or operate.
definitions.spread: open out so as to increase in surface area, width, or length.
